description: This file defines the interface 'FieldItemInterface' for entity field items in Drupal, specifying methods for property definitions, schema, entity access, property magic methods, rendering, saving, deletion, dependency management, and configuration handling.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Field\FieldItemInterface
classes.description: Interface for entity field items, extending ComplexDataInterface, defining methods for property definitions, schema, entity access, rendering, saving, deletion, dependencies, and configuration.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines field item properties as an array of property definitions, keyed by property name.

methods.name: mainPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the main property, or NULL if none.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the schema array for the field, or an empty array if none.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the entity that the field belongs to.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Gets the language code of the field values.

methods.name: getFieldDefinition
methods.description: Returns the field definition object.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to get a property value by name.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set a property value by name.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a property is set.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Magic method to unset a property.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Returns a renderable array for the field item, with display options.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Defines behavior before saving the field item.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Defines behavior after saving the field item.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Defines behavior for deleting the field item.

methods.name: deleteRevision
methods.description: Defines behavior for deleting a revision of the field item.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates placeholder values for the field.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings for the field.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default field settings.

methods.name: storageSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of storage-level settings.

methods.name: fieldSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of field-level settings.

methods.name: storageSettingsToConfigData
methods.description: Converts storage settings to a deployable configuration array.

methods.name: storageSettingsFromConfigData
methods.description: Loads storage settings from configuration data.

methods.name: fieldSettingsToConfigData
methods.description: Converts field settings to a deployable configuration array.

methods.name: fieldSettingsFromConfigData
methods.description: Loads field settings from configuration data.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Returns a form for storage-level settings.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Returns a form for field-level settings.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies for the field.

methods.name: calculateStorageDependencies
methods.description: Calculates storage dependencies for the field.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies for the field.
